query:
SELECT 
  u.id, u.email, 
  CASE WHEN u.passwordHash IS NOT NULL THEN 'email_user' ELSE 'oauth_user' END as user_type,
  u.tokenBalance,
  IFNULL(cr.campaignCode, 'NOT_CLAIMED') as bonus_status
FROM app_users u
LEFT JOIN campaign_redemptions cr ON cr.appUserId = u.id AND cr.campaignCode = 'welcome_bonus_2026'
WHERE u.email LIKE '%liad%' OR u.email LIKE '%118811%';
